title: A factorization modulo I of a monic polynomial into coprime monic factors lifts after an etale extension trivial modulo I
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $f\in A[x]$ a monic polynomial, with image $\bar f\in(A/I)[x]$. Let $\bar f=\bar g\bar h$ in $(A/I)[x]$ with $\bar g,\bar h$ monic and generating the unit ideal of $(A/I)[x]$. Then there exist a ring map $A\to A'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the induced map $\alpha:A/I\to A'/IA'$ is an isomorphism, and monic polynomials $g',h'\in A'[x]$ with $f=g'h'$ in $A'[x]$ ($f$ mapped to $A'[x]$) whose images in $(A'/IA')[x]$ are $\alpha(\bar g)$ and $\alpha(\bar h)$ ($\alpha$ applied coefficientwise).
